remarks: Available MAY 1. RENT INCLUDES heat, hot water, cooking gas, basic cable, basic internet, 1 reserved parking spot, and amenities!! WOW! Amenities include stunning oversized in-ground pool, gym, 24-hour gated security and bike room. Enjoy open layout, wood floors throughout (no carpets), living room that leads to your own balcony, all appliances under 3 years old, dishwasher, and ample closet space! Common laundry room in the basement. Lots of visitor parking. 27 minute walk to Stamford Station or 9 minute bike ride. 10 minute walk to top rated restaurants on Bedford Street & downtown events (Farmer's Markets, Thanksgiving Day Parade, Brews on Bedford, etc). 5 minute drive to I-95. MUST HAVE GOOD CREDIT. 2 Months Security Deposit. Renter's insurance is required. Move-in and move-out fees apply. Comes unfurnished. No pets.
